visualCharacteristics.layout: Single full-width rounded search input with the placeholder 'Search' and a round magnifier submit button inside its right edge. Renders a GET search form (role=search) that navigates to the authored search page with ?q=<term>; it does not query any index itself

contentPattern: One column: one link whose href is the search results page (e.g. /en/press/press-releases/) and whose text is the input placeholder. Optional key/value rows 'placeholder | Search' and 'label | <accessible label>'. Submitting navigates to {href}?q=<term> (empty term = results page unfiltered). If JS fails the authored link stays as a working link to the search page
